status_taxonomy.BUILT_AND_TESTED: Works with real data and backed by passing automated test
status_taxonomy.BUILT_UNTESTED: Works when run, but no automated test exists
status_taxonomy.PARTIAL: Some parts work, other claimed subcomponents are missing
status_taxonomy.MOCK_OR_SYNTHETIC: Uses fake, simulated, or mathematically synthetic target data
status_taxonomy.UNVERIFIED: Could not determine from available evidence

input_coarse_nwp_forecast.name: Coarse NWP Forecast Ingestion (ECMWF IFS / GFS)
input_coarse_nwp_forecast.real_source: Open-Meteo API (ECMWF IFS 0.25° & NOAA GFS); No IMD NWP; Nearest-grid rounding

input_historical_weather_training.name: Historical Training Targets
input_historical_weather_training.real_source: Synthetic deterministic formulas on coarse reanalysis + elevation/slope (Zero raw CHIRPS/ISD targets)

input_terrain_dem.name: Terrain / DEM Features
input_terrain_dem.real_source: NASA SRTM 30m v3 (Elevation min/mean/max, relief, slope; Aspect NOT computed)

input_land_cover.name: Land Cover & Vegetation Indices
input_land_cover.real_source: ESA WorldCover 10m v200 + Sentinel-2/MODIS 16-day NDVI composites

input_station_network.name: Station Ground Truth & Reference Network
input_station_network.real_source: 6 real ISD stations in Dhanbad/Eastern India; 5 MP airport stations offline; '55 stations' is hard-coded in UI API

engine_uncertainty_quantification.name: 80% Uncertainty Range & Coverage
engine_uncertainty_quantification.real_source: N=12 Bootstrap bagging ensemble (Not conformal prediction); '82.4% coverage' is hard-coded in API

engine_validation_baselines.name: Validation Protocol & Baseline Ladder
engine_validation_baselines.real_source: Temporal holdout (2020-2022 vs 2024) + Spatial holdout vs Coarse, Bilinear, Lapse-Rate, Quantile Mapping

engine_leakage_isolation.name: Data Leakage Isolation
engine_leakage_isolation.real_source: Clean temporal and spatial block splitting; however target leakage exists via mathematical formula derivation

trust_decision_cards.name: Cost-Loss Decision Engine Cards
trust_decision_cards.real_source: Murphy (1977) cost-loss engine built with YAML presets; UI API endpoint throws HTTP 500 error

trust_forecast_ledger.name: Tamper-Evident Forecast Ledger & Report Card
trust_forecast_ledger.real_source: SHA-256 hash-chained JSON archive (7 blocks); automated verifier script + contingency table metrics

trust_verifiability_decay.name: Verifiability Map & Station Distance Decay
trust_verifiability_decay.real_source: Haversine distance calculation to nearest station + exponential error degradation model

output_panchayat_forecast.name: Multi-Variable Panchayat Weather Forecast
output_panchayat_forecast.real_source: Rainfall, Temp Max/Min, RH, Wind Speed, ET0 with 80% CI stored in SQLite predictions table

output_reference_et0.name: FAO-56 Reference Evapotranspiration (ET0)
output_reference_et0.real_source: FAO-56 Hargreaves-Samani formulation driven by downscaled temperatures and extraterrestrial radiation Ra

output_agroadvisory_engine.name: Crop-Wise Agro-Meteorological Advisories
output_agroadvisory_engine.real_source: ICAR/KVK rules for 7 crops; GDD phenology tracking; sowing window planner; centralized IMD thresholds

output_disease_pest_risk.name: Disease & Pest Weather Risk Planners
output_disease_pest_risk.real_source: RH duration, wet canopy hours, temperature bounds (Blast, Rust, Mildew); generic active ingredients cited to KVK

output_web_gis_map.name: Web GIS Administrative Drilldown Map
output_web_gis_map.real_source: India (36 states), MP State, 55 MP Districts, 603 GP points; Block polygons missing; non-MP states not scored

output_dissemination_channels.name: Farmer Dissemination Channels (SMS / IVR / WhatsApp)
output_dissemination_channels.real_source: Simulated local Twilio webhook adapters; No Telegram bot; No Meta WhatsApp Cloud API; No paid telco gateway

output_crowdsourced_reports.name: Farmer Ground Observations (Crowdsourcing)
output_crowdsourced_reports.real_source: REST endpoints and SQLite crowd_reports table built (261 seed entries); excluded from ML scoring; simulated test records

engine_model_retraining.name: Automated Retraining & Recalibration
engine_model_retraining.real_source: Offline manual batch script (11_train_model.py); No automated daemon, cron, or streaming scheduler

governance_region_registry.name: Region Scope & Hierarchy Registry
governance_region_registry.real_source: Authoritative YAML registry (MP active, JH archived); Non-modelled states render graceful Out of Scope notice
